title: Protesters Demand Election Re-Run Over Ballot Shortage Controversy
detail: South Korean protesters continued demonstrations demanding a re-run of the June 3 local elections following a ballot shortage controversy that cast doubt on the vote's integrity. Protesters allege the shortage of ballots in certain districts suppressed turnout and undermined the legitimacy of results, calling for electoral authorities to address the discrepancy or order a fresh vote.

media.caption: South Korean protesters rallying to demand a re-run of the June 3 election over ballot shortage claims
